nodes.description: Proxy._delegate(address implementation) internal; performs inline-assembly delegatecall forwarding calldata to the implementation address.
Proxy._implementation() internal virtual view; abstract hook returning the delegatecall target address.
Proxy._fallback() internal; calls _beforeFallback() then _delegate(_implementation()).
Proxy fallback() external payable; delegates all unmatched calls to _fallback().
Proxy receive() external payable; delegates empty-calldata calls to _fallback().
Proxy._beforeFallback() internal virtual hook executed before delegation.
Address.isContract(address account) internal view; returns extcodesize(account) > 0.
Address.sendValue(address payable recipient, uint256 amount) internal; forwards ETH with a low-level call.
Address.functionCall(address target, bytes memory data) internal; 2-argument overload.
Address.functionCall(address target, bytes memory data, string memory errorMessage) internal; delegates to functionCallWithValue with value 0.
Address.functionCallWithValue(address target, bytes memory data, uint256 value) internal; 3-argument overload.
Address.functionCallWithValue(address target, bytes memory data, uint256 value, string memory errorMessage) internal; low-level call with value and result verification.
Address.functionStaticCall(address target, bytes memory data) internal; 2-argument overload.
Address.functionStaticCall(address target, bytes memory data, string memory errorMessage) internal; staticcall plus result verification.
Address._verifyCallResult(bool success, bytes memory returndata, string memory errorMessage) private pure; bubbles up revert data via assembly.
UpgradeableProxy constructor(address _logic, bytes memory _data) payable; sets implementation and optionally delegatecalls _data.
UpgradeableProxy._implementation() internal override view; loads the EIP1967 implementation slot.
UpgradeableProxy._upgradeTo(address newImplementation) internal; writes implementation and emits Upgraded.
UpgradeableProxy._setImplementation(address newImplementation) private; validates contract and sstores the implementation slot.
TransparentUpgradeableProxy constructor(address _logic, address admin_, bytes memory _data) payable; sets admin and implementation.
TransparentUpgradeableProxy.admin() external ifAdmin; returns the current admin.
TransparentUpgradeableProxy.implementation() external ifAdmin; returns the current implementation.
TransparentUpgradeableProxy.changeAdmin(address newAdmin) external ifAdmin; changes proxy admin.
TransparentUpgradeableProxy.upgradeTo(address newImplementation) external ifAdmin; upgrades the implementation.
TransparentUpgradeableProxy.upgradeToAndCall(address newImplementation, bytes calldata data) external payable ifAdmin; upgrades then delegatecalls data.
TransparentUpgradeableProxy._admin() internal view; loads the EIP1967 admin slot.
TransparentUpgradeableProxy._setAdmin(address newAdmin) private; sstores the admin slot.
TransparentUpgradeableProxy._beforeFallback() internal override virtual; blocks the admin from falling back to the implementation.
xKNCProxy constructor(address _logic, address _proxyAdmin); deploys the transparent proxy with empty init data.
